name: The Alliance Needs More Purple Lotus!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Purple Lotus!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Welcome back adventurer. Our collection grows, but even now we have a need for additional purple lotus. If it is still within your power to gather more of the herb, I entreat you to do so and return them to me here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome back, adventurer. Our collection grows, but even now we have a need for additional purple lotus. If it is still within your power to gather more of the herb, I entreat you to do so and return them to me here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I gladly accept your contribution on behalf of the Alliance, friend. Your efforts will directly lead to the creation of several potions and oils in support of our men and women in the field. Thank you, and should come across more, please consider returning to me.
